payload.name: Processing Fluency
payload.fact: Processing fluency, defined as the ease with which information is processed, can trigger positive affect and influence aesthetic preferences.
payload.boundary: The effect of processing fluency on preference is distinct from perceptual similarity and can be observed in various domains including visual stimuli, music, and truth judgments.
